title: Intravascular Lithotripsy Market Size to Reach USD 4.19 Billion by 2035 as Coronary and Peripheral IVL Adoption Accelerates – SNS Insider
author: Sns Insider
description: The global Intravascular Lithotripsy (IVL) market is projected to grow from USD 1.01 billion in 2025 to USD 4.19 billion by 2035, expanding at a 15.3% CAGR. Growth is driven by increasing prevalence of calcified coronary and peripheral artery disease, adoption of minimally invasive procedures, and expanding peripheral IVL applications. North America leads with 58% market share, while Asia-Pacific is the fastest-growing region.

title: Boston Scientific CEO Mahoney Buys More Than 200k Shares for $10 Million. What Does This Mean for Investors in 2026?
author: Brendan Coffey
description: Boston Scientific CEO Michael F. Mahoney purchased approximately 208,000 shares worth $10.1 million on August 3, 2026, at a weighted average price of $48.34 per share, expanding his equity stake by 13%. The purchase signals confidence in the company's future despite a -54% one-year stock decline, as the company benefits from recent acquisitions bolstering its product pipeline for 2027-2029 and a $500 million cost-cutting restructuring initiative.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: CEO's significant $10 million insider purchase of 208,000 shares signals strong confidence in future prospects. The purchase occurred despite recent -54% stock decline, suggesting management believes shares are undervalued. Company has strengthened product pipeline through acquisitions and is implementing $500 million operational cost cuts, indicating improving fundamentals ahead.

title: Ceribell Expands Board of Directors with Appointments of Thomas West and Sharon O’Keefe
author: Na
description: Ceribell announced the appointment of Thomas West and Sharon O'Keefe to its Board of Directors. West, former CEO of Nalu Medical (acquired by Boston Scientific for $600M) and Intersect ENT (acquired by Medtronic for $1.1B), and O'Keefe, former President of University of Chicago Medical Center, bring significant commercial and health-system leadership experience. The appointments support Ceribell's expansion as its point-of-care brain monitoring platform is now deployed in over 680 U.S. hospitals.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is expanding its market presence with 680+ hospital deployments and has attracted experienced executives to its board. The appointments of high-profile leaders from successful medtech exits and major health systems signal confidence in the company's growth trajectory and market leadership in point-of-care brain monitoring.

title: Implicity’s Next-Generation ILR ECG Analyzer Earns FDA Clearance
author: Not Specified
description: Implicity announced FDA 510(k) clearance for its next-generation ILR ECG Analyzer, a cloud-based AI software that reduces false-positive alerts from implantable cardiac monitors by up to 76% while maintaining high sensitivity. The manufacturer-agnostic algorithm works with devices from Abbott, Biotronik, Boston Scientific, and Medtronic, addressing a significant clinical workflow burden in remote cardiac monitoring.

title: Electrosurgery Market Projected to Reach $11.59 Billion by 2031 as Demand for Minimally Invasive Procedures Rises - Analysis by Product, Surgery, End User and Region
author: Researchandmarkets.Com
description: The global electrosurgery market is projected to grow from $8.01 billion in 2025 to $11.59 billion by 2031, with a CAGR of 6.4%. Growth is driven by increasing surgical volumes, rising chronic disease prevalence, and adoption of minimally invasive procedures. However, challenges include procedural risks, regulatory constraints, and surgeon shortages. Ambulatory surgical centers are expanding their role, while the United States leads North American growth.
